_comment: Voice identity for every episode. status fields are honest: nothing here is verified until `ffx doctor --live` confirms it with a real key.

voice.name: Koda

libraryFacts.description: 21-year-old Influencer from the Inland South. Tone is objective, direct, and helpful

voice.note: Found by `ffx voices --search Koda` on 2026-10-27 (Muse). Two things to judge by ear at gate G2: the library lists an Inland Southern accent and a young influencer persona, while the channel wants a neutral American, authoritative, calm financial-advisor delivery. If the sample does not fit, pick another library voice; do not stretch the style prompt to force it. The request field that carries this id is UNVERIFIED until the first real synthesis call.

model.note: Google's TTS page (read via Muse, 2026-10-27) documents the Gemini 3.8 models as the current ones: 3.8 Flash for studio-grade narration and stable long-form voice, 3.8 Flash-Lite as the cheap high-volume option, and 3.1 Flash Preview as the older model. The 3.1 ID was confirmed as listed on 2026-10-27; run `ffx doctor --live` to confirm that the 3.8 IDs are listed for this key before the first sample. Request shape differs from 3.1 (speech_metadata annotations), so the tool targets 3.8.

style: Authoritative, calm financial advisor delivery with a warm, confident tone, steady downward inflections, and clear, measured pacing.
styleRules: Keep the style string identical for every request of an episode (and across episodes).
The text field is spoken verbatim: no stage directions in it.
Only <short pause> and <long pause> inline tags; sound effects come from the sound plan, not the voice.
Never ask the model to 'keep the voice steady' (documented to increase drift).
Do not put age, gender or accent changes in style; choose a different library voice instead.

styleVariants.user: Authoritative, calm financial advisor delivery with a warm, confident tone, steady downward inflections, and clear, measured pacing.

request.variantNote: Google advises an empty or short, constant style and warns long style text increases drift. Audition all three on the same sentence and keep one.
request.emphasis: capitalise a word for vocal stress
